overview.title: Resumen del programa
overview.description: The Practical Nursing Program at Compu-Med Vocational Careers (CMVC) is a comprehensive 52-week diploma designed to prepare students for a career as licensed practical nurses (LPNs). The program combines theoretical instruction with clinical experiences and clinical simulation across specialties such as medical-surgical, pharmacology, geriatrics, obstetrics and pediatrics, and prepares graduates to be eligible to take the NCLEX-PN state board exam.

faq.question: What is the Practical Nursing Program?
faq.answer: The Practical Nursing Program at CMVC is a comprehensive 52-week diploma designed to prepare students for a career as licensed practical nurses (LPNs), combining theoretical instruction with clinical experiences and simulation.

faq.question: How long is the program and how many credits are required?
faq.answer: The program is 52 weeks in length and requires 46 semester credits.

faq.question: Will I be eligible to take the NCLEX-PN after completing the program?
faq.answer: Yes. Upon successful completion of the Practical Nursing Program, graduates will be eligible to sit for the NCLEX-PN state board exam.

faq.question: Are there online course requirements?
faq.answer: Students taking online courses must meet technical requirements such as a current operating system, stable internet, up-to-date browsers, antivirus software, and word processing software; some courses may require additional software.
